packages.name: pg
packages.ownedCapability: Server-only PostgreSQL protocol client for Supabase transaction-pooler function calls
packages.nativeAlternativeRationale: Node.js has no native PostgreSQL wire client; direct function-only database access avoids browser Data API and service_role bypasses
